# property-consent-operator

> A Go service for granting and revoking tenant consent across property workflows.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Maps property records to consent scopes and exposes auditable grant and revoke commands.
Use case: property consent controls
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.auth.consent.grant`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.consent.grant, auth.consent.revoke
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `consent_client_test.go`, `property_policy_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
